entities.evidence: Genesis 5:15 names Jared as Mahalalel’s son. Here Jared fathers Enoch, matching the source tag.

Jared is the subject of “fathered,” and אֶת marks Enoch as his son in this genealogy. That relationship identifies the bearer tagged here and distinguishes him from the sons of Cain, Midian, and Reuben.

analysis.evidence: יֶרֶד (Jared) is the subject of וַיְחִי. The following count of 162 years gives the duration Jared lived before he fathered Enoch.
analysis.morphology: Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine singular, with prefixed וַ־ and an apocopated verb form.
analysis.sense: to live for a stated length of time

analysis.evidence: יֶרֶד is the subject of וַיְחִי (“he lived”). The verse says that Jared lived 162 years and then fathered Enoch (וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת חֲנוֹךְ), continuing the genealogy that names Jared as Mahalalel’s son in Genesis 5:15.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular proper noun, without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: In שְׁתַּיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה, שְׁתַּיִם supplies the two in ‘sixty-two years.’ Its feminine form agrees with שָׁנָה. The following וּמְאַת שָׁנָה adds a hundred years, giving Jared’s age as 162 when he fathered Enoch.
In שְׁתַּיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה, the marked word adds sixty to two to give sixty-two years. The following וּמְאַת שָׁנָה adds a hundred, giving Jared’s age as 162.
analysis.morphology: Conjunction וְ־ prefixed to a cardinal numeral, common gender, plural form, absolute state.

analysis.evidence: In שְׁתַּיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה, the marked noun supplies the unit for sixty-two. וּמְאַת שָׁנָה adds a hundred years, giving Jared’s age as 162 when he fathered Enoch.
analysis.morphology: Common noun, feminine singular absolute, with no prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: וּמְאַת שָׁנָה means ‘and a hundred years’. This adds one hundred to the preceding sixty-two years, giving Jared’s age as 162 when he fathered Enoch.
analysis.morphology: Conjunction וּ־ ‘and’ prefixed to מְאַת, the singular construct form of the cardinal numeral מֵאָה.

analysis.evidence: In וּמְאַת שָׁנָה, the marked noun supplies the unit for “one hundred years.” Added to the preceding sixty-two years, it gives Jared’s age of 162 when he fathered Enoch.
analysis.morphology: Feminine singular absolute noun, without prefix or suffix
